description: Turns OSC messages from the Holon.ist iOS app, or from any OSC sender on the network, into eight control voltages

params.text: Attenuates the value arriving on that channel, from nothing through to full level
Fully counter-clockwise the channel passes each arriving value at once; turning clockwise smooths the jump from one value to the next
Picks which of the eight OSC buses, A to H, this module reads; a second copy set to another bus gives another eight channels
Multiplies arriving CV values by ten, so a value sent in the range -1 to 1 becomes -10V to 10V; gates, triggers and the app's own LFO shapes are unchanged by it
On, that channel's output is renewed only on a rising edge at the clock input; with nothing patched to that input the output follows the incoming values continuously

inputs.text: A rising edge renews every output whose s/h switch is on; outputs with the switch off are unaffected

outputs.text: The voltage for that channel, clipped to -10V to 10V, with its lamp green for positive and red for negative

notes: OSC arrives on UDP port 9000, and the module advertises itself over Bonjour so that Holon.ist finds it; the app also sends the channel names printed against the outputs
The outputs stay at 0V until an OSC sender reaches the module and sends on the bus the bus knob has selected; the lamp beside a channel flashes when a value arrives on it
